remarks: Welcome to The Village at Stamford Landing - a rare opportunity to own a stunning 2 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom top floor condo with breathtaking water views in the heart of Stamford. This charming residence offers a perfect blend of elegance and convenience, with its spacious layout, modern amenities, and serene waterfront location. Step inside to discover an open concept living area that flows effortlessly, with soaring ceiling height, ample natural light, and stunning views. The living room is perfect for relaxing or entertaining, and the adjacent dining area offers ample space for gatherings along with a wet bar. The gourmet kitchen is well-equipped with a Wolf range, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar. The primary suite is a true retreat, boasting en-suite marble bathroom, walk-in-closet, and expansive water views. Also included is a coveted boat slip. Additional amenities include a pool and 2 garage parking spaces. Don't miss the opportunity to own a piece of waterfront luxury!
